exit_codes.0: No implemented blocking gate failed; future NOT_IMPLEMENTED gates still make project integrity PARTIAL.
exit_codes.1: At least one implemented blocking gate failed.
exit_codes.2: Integrity contract or checker execution failed internally.

test_policy.known_current_limitation: jsonschema-dependent Word Timeline tests may skip until Issue #58/G4 defines dependency truth. Every skip remains visible and makes G7 WARN.

gates.name: Git Truth
gates.invariant: Repository identity, cleanliness, origin/main relation, and required tracked runtime source are truthful.

gates.name: Runtime Truth
gates.invariant: Any detected installed runtime is complete and byte-identical to repository-governed runtime source.

gates.name: Governance Truth
gates.invariant: The existing repository governance checker passes and does not mutate governed files.

gates.name: Dependency Truth
gates.reason: Activated by Issue #58 or a dedicated governed dependency-contract follow-up.

gates.name: Canonical Contract Truth
gates.reason: Future gate will compose all accepted canonical schemas and cross-record validators.

gates.name: End-to-End Truth
gates.reason: Future gate requires an explicit supported end-to-end fixture; expensive ML/model execution is outside v1.

gates.name: Test Truth
gates.invariant: The supported full pytest command is executed; failures and skips are never hidden.

gates.name: Product State Truth
gates.invariant: Version, declared CLI commands, and production-integration maturity claims do not contradict repository reality.
